sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "households" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 UNIQUE CHECK (singleton = 1), "lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "rules_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "domain_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "latest_local_day" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "child_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES households(id), "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (active_pet_id IN ('fox', 'rabbit', 'cat')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "window_math_bookmarks" ("child_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES child_profiles(id), "page" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (page IN ('count', 'missing', 'sunny', 'puzzle', 'finished')), "first_pane" INTEGER, "second_pane" INTEGER, CHECK((page != 'finished' AND first_pane IS NULL AND second_pane IS NULL)OR(page = 'finished' AND first_pane IS NOT NULL AND second_pane IS NOT NULL AND first_pane BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND second_pane BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND first_pane < second_pane)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "child_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES child_profiles(id), "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (balance >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('once', 'recurring', 'staged')), "current_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (current_version >= 1), "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paused IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_templates(id), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "criteria" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reward" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reward BETWEEN 2 AND 5), "rules_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(template_id, version));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_stages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_versions(id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence >= 1), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "criteria" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reward" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reward BETWEEN 2 AND 5), UNIQUE(version_id, sequence));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_instances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "instance_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_templates(id), "version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_versions(id), "stage_id" TEXT REFERENCES project_stages(id), "prior_instance_id" TEXT REFERENCES task_instances(id), "planned_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "due_day" TEXT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('OPEN', 'SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED', 'APPROVED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'CORRECTED', 'WAITING')), "actual_date" TEXT, "approved_at" INTEGER, "resolution_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE INDEX task_state_idx ON task_instances (state, planned_day)
CREATE INDEX task_plan_idx ON task_instances (template_id, planned_day, slot)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "submissions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "instance_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_instances(id), "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX submission_instance_idx ON submissions (instance_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "instance_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES task_instances(id), "actual_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "feedback" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_valid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_valid IN (0, 1)), "approval_command_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE INDEX completion_date_idx ON completions (is_valid, actual_date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (balance_after >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reward', 'penalty', 'penalty_reversal', 'purchase', 'refund', 'correction')), "source_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "reversal_of" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_entries(id), "actual_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "posted_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "processed_commands" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "payload_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "penalty_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "behavior" TEXT NOT NULL, "condition_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "points" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (points BETWEEN 1 AND 3));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "penalty_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES penalty_rules(id), "fact" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "posted_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_points" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (planned_points BETWEEN 1 AND 3), "deducted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (deducted BETWEEN 0 AND planned_points), "ledger_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_entries(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "penalty_day_usage" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "posted_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "used" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (used BETWEEN 0 AND 3), PRIMARY KEY(account_id, posted_day));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_paid > 0), "ledger_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_entries(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refunded_at" INTEGER, "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX purchased_once ON purchases (item_id) WHERE refunded_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "scene_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT REFERENCES purchases(id), "layout_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entitlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases(id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT CHECK (slot IN ('head', 'face', 'neck', 'body')), "bound_space" TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id), "revoked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revoked IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE(purchase_id, item_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_entitlement ON entitlements (item_id) WHERE revoked = 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "placements" ("entitlement_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES entitlements(id), "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id), "x" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (x BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "y" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (y BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "rotation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "flipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (flipped IN (0, 1)), "z" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mount_id" TEXT, UNIQUE(space_id, mount_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_state" ("pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (pet_id IN ('fox', 'rabbit', 'cat')), "slot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (slot IN ('head', 'face', 'neck', 'body')), "entitlement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entitlements(id), PRIMARY KEY(pet_id, slot));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "growth_awards" ("child_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES child_profiles(id), "threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stage BETWEEN 2 AND 6), "awarded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(child_id, threshold));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wishes" ("child_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES child_profiles(id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "selected_price" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selected_price > 0), "selected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "correction_records" ("instance_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES task_instances(id), "original_reward_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_entries(id), "recovered" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recovered >= 0), "shortfall" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shortfall >= 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "refunded_purchase_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE INDEX ledger_day_kind_idx ON ledger_entries (posted_day, kind)
CREATE INDEX purchase_ledger_idx ON purchases (ledger_id, refunded_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "base_furnishings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id IN ('base_bed', 'base_rug')), "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id), "x" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (x BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "y" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (y BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "flipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (flipped IN (0, 1)), "z" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "window_story_milestones" ("child_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES child_profiles(id));
